summary: Give your base room to grow: extra range, chest slots and Palbox boxes as you level up. Five adjustable world settings, native rewards and a blue upgrade celebration. For host/server and clients.
intro: Give your base room to grow—and enjoy the moment it does. Growing Grounds adds meaningful rewards to your base upgrades, with current and next values in the game's own menu.

sections.title: More room to build
sections.alt: Default radius illustrated to scale: 35 m at level 1, 49 m at level 11, 70 m at level 26.
sections.text: Choose your gain per upgrade and maximum bonus independently. Defaults give +4% per upgrade, capped at +100%. Nearby bases can limit expansion. Each upgrade celebrates with the blue wave and rising glow.

sections.title: More room for supplies
sections.text: Chests gain 18 bonus slots gradually across the base levels. Guild Chests receive the bonus once for their shared inventory. Occupied extra slots stay until emptied when you lower the cap.

sections.title: More boxes for your Pals
sections.alt: Regular Palbox capacity illustrated: 32 starting boxes to 64 total boxes, with whole boxes unlocking gradually.
sections.text: Start with 32 boxes and grow to 64 total—or choose your own start and maximum, such as 1 → 16. Your guild's progression applies once; extra bases do not multiply it. Occupied, locked or open boxes are kept. Global Palbox storage is unchanged.

sections.title: Your world. Your pace.
sections.text: Five controls beside the game’s base/building settings: range gain 0–20% per upgrade (default 4%), range cap 0–300% (default 100%), chest bonus 0–42 in steps of six (default 18), and starting/maximum total Palbox boxes 1–96 (default 32 → 64). Dedicated servers use config.lua.

install: Install on the host/server and clients with a compatible Palworld UE4SS loader. Update both sides and preserve your settings. GG’s automatic-backup companion is removed in 0.2.1-beta; existing archives are kept. If upgrading from 0.2.0-beta, follow the installation guide to remove the old GG launcher and replace the mod folder. Default rewards and menu layout were checked in game through Proton/Wine. Smaller starting Palbox capacities, the latest audit refactor in game, and physical Windows testing remain pending.
feedback: We'd love to see what you build! Share your base, leave a comment, or report a bug so we can investigate and improve Growing Grounds together.
credits: Made with OpenAI Codex and Claude under lelorax's direction. Unofficial Palworld mod. Free to use; reuploads, published modifications and reuse require permission.
